name: Personal agent current work and next actions
summary: Personal attention retains bounded work snapshots, owner-filtered recovery, live authority and separate snapshot/own/action truncation. Only blockers/dependencies block undelivered work; delivered review takes precedence. Other authors flag blocked and in-progress tasks; own comments remain quiet and missing checkpoints leave activity unknown. Flagged in-progress tasks sort first within that priority before the action cap. Counts and summaries include all observed owned undelivered flags, with lower bounds for incomplete own reads. links.task is the task row; links.brief leads to the actual brief. Its bounded newer summary keeps counts, references, omissions and coverage, provides the authorized web history route and omits SSH-only helpers. Reading acknowledges nothing; errors and unknown counts never imply idle.
